upstream.scope: Generic report of a user-cleared List, Table or Tree selection (§4 inv. 13, §6.3, §7.6, §7.7, §8, §18.2, §22.5, §27, §32): SELECTION_CHANGED with no value, specified in spec/registries.md, with Rust and Swift constructors and reader, client plumbing, adapter emission, and adoption by ui-gallery, process-monitor and srtop; no registry, proto or framing change and no application-specific client path

entries.feature: SELECTION_CHANGED with no value on a List, Table or Tree means a user action left the collection with nothing selected; servers treat it as clearing the selection and never as malformed, a present non-ItemId value stays malformed, a server-caused deselection sends nothing, multiple selection stays one event per item and a partial deselection stays unreported; specified in spec/registries.md §4.2 and §4.4 with the compatibility note, registry description updated, generated outputs unchanged

Rust Event::selection_cleared and Event::selection_change returning SelectionChange::{Item, Cleared} (None for a malformed value or another event type), re-exported by srui-sdk; Swift Event.selectionCleared; the argumentless event round-trips on the wire
